title: Sea La Vie Seaside | Real Joy
meta_description: Why Guests Love This Home• Private pool + spa — rare in Seaside Proper• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Access to Seaside amenities, including pools, tennis, pickleball, and fitness center• Designer interiors and high-end furnishings• Rooftop sitting area
description_expanded: Why Guests Love This Home• Private pool + spa — rare in Seaside Proper• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Access to Seaside amenities, including pools, tennis, pickleball, and fitness center• Designer interiors and high-end furnishings• Rooftop sitting area with Gulf views• Elevator (Main House)• Multiple living spaces—ideal for groups• Complimentary 6 bikes to explore 30A• Includes separate 2BR Carriage House• Professionally managed with 24/7 support• Snowbird-friendly (Jan–Feb monthly stays)• Minimum age to book: 25________________________________________About This SpaceSea La Vie Seaside blends upscale comfort with the classic charm of Seaside Proper. Steps from the Gulf and designed for gatherings, this luxury retreat features a private pool, attached spa, rooftop deck, and two fully appointed homes: the Main House and an upgraded 2-bedroom Carriage House.Perfect for multi-family vacations or groups seeking extra privacy, the property offers designer décor, spacious suites, and thoughtfully curated interiors throughout. Enjoy easy walkability to Seaside Square’s dining and shopping, or head straight to the private Tupelo Street Pavilion beach access just 60 yards away.________________________________________The SpaceMain House (4BR • 4.5BA)First Floor• Bedroom 1: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds• Bedroom 2: King BedSecond Floor• Primary Suite: King Bed• Bedroom 3: King BedMain House Highlights• Three separate living areas• Fully equipped chef’s kitchen• Designer furnishings + coastal décor• Multiple balconies with outdoor seating• Rooftop deck with Gulf views• Private pool + spa (available only to main house guests)________________________________________Carriage House (2BR • 2.5BA)A private, stand-alone guest home perfect for couples, extended family, or guests who want additional privacy.First Floor• Open-concept living room• Dining area for four• Full kitchen with appliances and essentials• Half bathroomSecond Floor• Bedroom 1: King Bed, en suite full bathroom• Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, en suite full bathroom________________________________________Guest AccessGuests booking Sea La Vie Seaside (entire property) have private access to:• Main House• Carriage House• Pool and spa • Rooftop deck• All exterior spaces• Driveway parking• Complimentary 6 bikes Access to the Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach entrance is included for all guests.________________________________________Other Things to Note• Minimum age to book is 25• Pool heat optional for $75/night• Snowbird rentals available January–February (monthly only)• Monthly stays incur an additional $150 cleaning fee (per property)• Seaside community rules and quiet hours apply________________________________________The NeighborhoodLocated in Seaside Proper, one of the most iconic communities along 30A, Sea La Vie puts you within a short walk of:• Seaside Square shops, restaurants, and events• Local food trucks• Coffee shops + boutiques• Bike rentals and the 30A path• WaterColor and Grayton BeachNearby adventures include paddleboarding, kayaking, golf, nature trails, fishing, and snorkeling at the Sea Turtle Reef near Grayton Beach State Park.
